blame_container: The model, the benchmark, the paper, the open-source community
laundering_mechanism: Corporate deployment control hides behind scientific language and benchmark culture.
control_benefit_vector: Firms controlling compute, data, deployment, logs, product channels, and safety policy.
record_control: AI Index reports, model releases, deployment records.
outcome_status: Industry produces most notable frontier models; academia remains important to research legitimacy.
narrative_line: Academia supplies legitimacy; industry controls deployment.
caution: Use current AI Index numbers with date/version check before publication.

event: Meta Llama 4 and LMArena / leaderboard controversy
blame_container: The leaderboard, ELO score, best-in-class claim
laundering_mechanism: Marketing turns contested evaluation procedure into objective public rank.
control_benefit_vector: Model provider variants, benchmark access, disclosure rules, arena governance.
record_control: Model release blog, leaderboard records, research critiques, LMArena responses.
outcome_status: Controversy led to calls for improved labeling and transparency.
narrative_line: A leaderboard launders strategy into science-looking rank.
caution: Do not call cheating unless evidence proves it; frame as metric-governance problem.

blame_container: Crowd preference, arena votes, benchmark voters
laundering_mechanism: “Users prefer it” masks optimization toward a narrow public contest.
control_benefit_vector: Benchmark incentives, model tuning, data generation, voting safeguards.
record_control: Research papers, vendor statements, reporting on arena-targeted labor.
outcome_status: Manipulability research exists; specific commercial practices disputed.
narrative_line: If the reward is leaderboard rank, the system will learn the leaderboard before the world.
caution: Separate theoretical vulnerability from proven manipulation.

blame_container: Public data, web-scale training, fair use, dataset
laundering_mechanism: Human expressive work is dissolved into impersonal training corpus.
control_benefit_vector: Collection choices, licensing choices, filtering choices, training objectives, commercial deployment.
record_control: Copyright Office report, lawsuits, settlements, court rulings.
outcome_status: Legal landscape developing; major cases and settlements continue.
narrative_line: The word “data” can make human labor disappear.
caution: Do not assume one legal answer across all uses, sources, and jurisdictions.

event: California training-data transparency and xAI challenge
blame_container: Trade secrets, competitive harm, state overreach
laundering_mechanism: Opacity is defended as competitive necessity, making responsibility harder to reconstruct.
control_benefit_vector: Developers’ knowledge of training data, disclosure law, trade secrets, compliance.
record_control: State law, court rulings, company filings.
outcome_status: Reported preliminary relief denied; legal fight ongoing.
narrative_line: Secrecy becomes dangerous when it makes public accountability impossible.
caution: Verify current docket before manuscript.

blame_container: Foreign competitor, distillation, unauthorized output use
laundering_mechanism: Incumbents defend broad learning from public material while accusing rivals of improper learning from model outputs.
control_benefit_vector: API terms, output logs, training practices, competitive strategy, national-security framing.
record_control: Company statements, market reaction, investigations, congressional testimony.
outcome_status: Allegations and investigations; not fully adjudicated.
narrative_line: Everyone wants permissionless learning for themselves and enforceable boundaries against rivals.
caution: Do not equate legally distinct categories: public web data, copyrighted work, API outputs, trade secrets.

event: Open-weight versus open-source claims around Llama
blame_container: Open source, community, downstream users
laundering_mechanism: Openness gives reputational credit while pushing downstream misuse risk onto community.
control_benefit_vector: Release terms, license restrictions, capability level, safety mitigations, deployment support.
record_control: Model licenses, OSI commentary, company blogs.
outcome_status: Ongoing debate over terminology and responsibilities.
narrative_line: “We released it openly” can become “what others do is no longer our responsibility.”
caution: Balance benefits of openness with accountability concerns.

blame_container: The model, tuning, safety guardrails
laundering_mechanism: Value-laden product decision is reframed as calibration error.
control_benefit_vector: Product design, evaluation coverage, policy choices, launch threshold.
record_control: Company explanation, product rollback/pause, public examples.
outcome_status: Google paused feature and explained tuning problem.
narrative_line: The model did not decide the guardrail; people did.
book_use: Compact case for product guardrail decisions.
caution: Avoid culture-war overstatement; focus on design responsibility.

blame_container: User feedback, model personality, reinforcement process
laundering_mechanism: “The model learned what users like” hides company optimization of short-term satisfaction.
control_benefit_vector: Reward modeling, deployment review, safety testing, engagement incentives.
record_control: Company admission, rollback note, model release records.
outcome_status: OpenAI rolled back/update adjusted and publicly analyzed failure.
narrative_line: A model trained to please can launder the company’s appetite for engagement.
book_use: One of the cleanest AI cases.
caution: Use company’s own words; avoid extrapolating beyond this incident.

blame_container: User prompts, deprecated code, unfiltered personality, temporary update
laundering_mechanism: Edgy product identity becomes plausible deniability when model crosses a line.
control_benefit_vector: Product positioning, moderation thresholds, update process, testing, rollback capacity.
record_control: Public outputs, company apology, Reuters/AP/Wired reporting.
outcome_status: Company apology and code/update explanation; full internal chain not public.
narrative_line: A company cannot sell “unfiltered” as a feature and treat filter failure as surprise.
caution: Distinguish public outputs from internal causation.

blame_container: Summarization, search evolution, user convenience, publisher indexing

outcome_status: Feature adjusted; publisher suits/claims ongoing.
narrative_line: AI search can make the publisher invisible while feeding on the publisher’s work.
caution: Not every summary is unlawful; focus on distribution power and publisher dependency.

blame_container: Facts are public, citations exist, the web is open, scraper intermediary

narrative_line: The answer engine makes source labor optional-looking.

event: System cards and frontier safety frameworks
blame_container: System card, safety framework, red-team process, voluntary commitment

control_benefit_vector: Release decision, deployment limits, enforcement power, incident response.
record_control: Company system cards, Seoul commitments, preparedness frameworks.
outcome_status: Safety documentation increasing; enforcement varies.
narrative_line: System cards are anti-laundering when they create obligations; theater when they only confess.
caution: Do not dismiss disclosure; distinguish useful documentation from accountability theater.

blame_container: Contractor, outsourcing firm, content-moderation pipeline, data work
laundering_mechanism: The model appears clean because hidden workers absorb toxic content and low-status labor.
control_benefit_vector: Companies demanding cleaned datasets, contractors setting conditions, procurement pressure.

outcome_status: Supply-chain scrutiny increasing; many details remain opaque.
narrative_line: Safety is sold at the interface; injury is pushed into the supply chain.
caution: Avoid overgeneralizing from one vendor/country to all data work.

blame_container: Writing assistance, reviewer workload, productivity tool
laundering_mechanism: Reviewer keeps authority while outsourcing evaluative language to a system.
control_benefit_vector: Reviewer judgment, conference policy, editor oversight, confidentiality, author rights.

outcome_status: Research estimated substantial LLM modification in some peer-review text.
narrative_line: A reviewer can sign a review while the author cannot cross-examine the machine that shaped it.
caution: Separate grammar assistance from judgment outsourcing.
